title: Activity patterns (get_activity_patterns)
notes: Heatmap answers must be in local time (a UTC argmax differs by 4-5h -- a UTC-shaped answer means LOCAL_TZ isn't reaching the reply). Series answers must not recite all 12 buckets when 2 sentences answer the question (communication axis).

cases.prompt: What hour of the day do I text the most?
cases.grader_notes: argmax hour of heatmap (LOCAL_TZ); reply names that hour
cases.quality_watch: Must be the LOCAL_TZ argmax: grade accuracy 0 if the reply matches the UTC argmax (stored in GT raw as utc_top_hour) instead of the local one -- that means LOCAL_TZ isn't reaching the reply.

cases.prompt: What's the busiest day of the week for me and <TOP1>?
How many texts did <TOP1> and I exchange each month of <YEAR>?
cases.grader_notes: volume_series for <YEAR>; spot-check 3 months exactly; sent/received split preserved
cases.quality_watch: Must not recite all 12 buckets when 2 sentences answer the question.

cases.prompt: Am I texting more or less this year than last year?
cases.grader_notes: compare the two year buckets; reply gets the direction right and cites both totals

cases.prompt: How much do I text after midnight, and who's on the other end?
cases.grader_notes: late_night share + top_contacts leaderboard; named contact = GT #1

cases.prompt: What's the longest streak of consecutive days <TOP1> and I have talked?
What was my single busiest texting day ever?
Did <SPARSE> and I text much in <YEAR>?
cases.grader_notes: small GT count; reply gives the number and honestly frames it as light traffic
